This repository is a Kotlin Multiplatform project for native D-Bus support.

`src/commonMain/kotlin`: shared API/serialization. `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop`: Linux native impl/C interop. `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}`: native tests/fixtures. `codegen/`: JVM CLI/library for XML-to-Kotlin codegen. `plugin/`: Gradle plugin (`com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin`) built on `:codegen`. `compile_test/`: compile-time integration wiring. `samples/bluez-scan/`: example consumer.

Use repo-root Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build`
`./gradlew test`
`./gradlew ktlintCheck`
